reserveReview.rationale: Single-slot finalized Solana Account Archive renewal at slot 472595150 (blockhash fdLiDwvY5dGFgPJGE68cNWcMkKySCg7YCAZsMJQdWDL, 2026-11-22T15:43:01Z; docs.hubbleprotocol.io currently fails DNS, so on-chain program state decoded with official @hubbleprotocol/hubble-config@8.0.0 and hubble-sdk@8.0.5 IDLs is authoritative). USDH mint supply is 1,121,043.234924 USDH. Issuance-path liabilities at the same slot total 1,121,091.034524 USDH (+47.799600 USDH, +0.0043% reconciliation): PSM Reserve PDA 7AvwR...c747 records 1,056,080.632049 USDC deposited and 1,056,080.632049 USDH minted (matching psmVault 3U8M8...hJwN SPL USDC balance exactly; separate PSM fee treasury HoXoF...dSFi holds 26,119.459282 USDC and is excluded; protocol USDH fee/treasury/stability-pool accounts holding 15,507.41 / 13,378.99 / 36,913.18 USDH sit inside circulating supply and are excluded from backing), plus borrowing-market debt of 45,846.416470 USDH in market0 (4.0894%), 2.058051 USDH in market1 (0.0002%), and 19,161.927954 USDH in market2 (1.7092%). Each market's own debt is attributed directly to its active depositedCollateral (verified vault-by-vault to match deposited + inactive SPL balances to the atomic unit). For market2 (21,041.140914 kUSDH-USDC shares), Scope[42] is a FixedPrice (type=23) $1.00 placeholder; direct on-chain look-through of deprecated Kamino WhirlpoolStrategy Cfuy5T6...dXXEN (status=2) and Orca position GdS4B...5r (liquidity=0) shows 26,985.584074 USDH in tokenAVault and 1,910.591992 USDC in tokenBVault across 27,528.883627 sharesIssued, splitting market2's 1.7092% liability into 1.5962% self-referential USDH (disposition: self-reserve, ownLiability: true) and 0.1130% USDC. For market0, active collateral is valued from same-slot Scope live feeds (mSOL 892.936041 at $99.70 = $89,025.46; SOL 461.154581 at $70.35 = $32,440.24; daoSOL 72.645844 via Scope[10]*Scope[0] at $88.29 = $6,413.73; Portal WETH 0.317106 at $1,715.54 = $544.01; RAY 22.303263 at $1.31 = $29.30) and Solido on-chain exchange rate (stSOL 22.850616 at 1.296276 SOL/stSOL = $2,083.69). Market0 tokenId 2 (0.104830 Sollet soBTC, mint 9n4nb...J9E) is post-FTX impaired Sollet BTC trading near $84.36 (~$8.84), not canonical BTC ($60,756.44 on Scope[2], which overstated it by 720x in August); Scope indices 19 (LDO), 5 (soFTT), and 3 (SRM) are FixedPrice 1e-6 placeholders, and DefiLlama/CoinGecko mint-exact spots bound all four impaired/placeholder assets combined at ~$23.66 (0.0181% of market0 collateral, 0.0007% of total USDH), grouped with stSOL, Portal WETH, RAY, and market1 Solend cSOL (0.844600 cSOL = $71.10 at Solend reserve rate 1.196604 SOL/cSOL) into the 0.0841% residual slice. Independent 4-decimal rounding sums to 99.9999% with no artificial plug.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Single-slot finalized Solana Account Archive decode at slot 472595150 (blockhash fdLiDwvY5dGFgPJGE68cNWcMkKySCg7YCAZsMJQdWDL, 2026-11-22T15:43:01Z): PSM minted/deposited USDC and per-market borrowing debt normalized over issuance-path liabilities (reconciling to USDH supply within 0.0043%), with direct Kamino kUSDH-USDC vault look-through, live Scope/Solido/Solend on-chain pricing, and DefiLlama/CoinGecko bounds for impaired Sollet soBTC and Scope FixedPrice dust
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Market0 retains four tiny residual positions lacking reliable live Scope feeds at slot 472595150: impaired Sollet soBTC (0.104830, Scope[2] uses generic BTC), Wormhole LDO (33.570024), Sollet soFTT (37.678774), and SRM (23.780016), where Scope indices 19, 5, and 3 carry FixedPrice 1e-6 placeholders. Mint-exact market spots bound all four combined at ~$23.66 (0.0007% of total USDH), included inside the 0.0841% Other CDP collateral slice. Kamino kUSDH-USDC strategy Cfuy5T6...dXXEN is deprecated (status=2) with 100.019843 burned shares between sharesIssued (27,528.883627) and sharesMint supply (27,428.863784) plus negligible uncollected Orca fees (2.59 USDH, 2.53 USDC), which do not change the 93.39% USDH / 6.61% USDC look-through ratio. Active borrow/redemption execution outside PSM (blockRedeem=true on GlobalConfig; blockPsmBurn=false with 50 bps fee) remains unverified by transaction replay.
